subject.title: fix(discord): send fresh final messages after previews

question: Should this PR wait for live Discord unread/highlight and broadcast-suppression proof before merge, or should maintainers explicitly override that proof gate?
rationale: Source and mock tests show the intended delivery path, but they cannot prove Discord client unread/highlight behavior or live mention parsing for the external PR's changed user flow.

options.title: Wait for live Discord proof
options.body: Require a redacted Discord recording, screenshots with diagnostics, or runtime logs showing the source channel becomes unread/highlighted and `@everyone`/`@here` does not broadcast after the patch.

options.title: Override the proof gate
options.body: A maintainer can accept source-level proof and mock payload tests as sufficient, owning the residual Discord-client behavior risk.

options.title: Pause for product direction
options.body: If fresh final messages should not become the default for all partial-preview users, pause this PR and route the default/config choice through the related finalization-policy issue.

recommendation.title: Wait for live Discord proof
recommendation.body: Require a redacted Discord recording, screenshots with diagnostics, or runtime logs showing the source channel becomes unread/highlighted and `@everyone`/`@here` does not broadcast after the patch.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the current assignee and authored the follow-up commits that address the prior review finding, so he is the best available owner for the proof or override decision.
